definitions.explanation: Refers to any thing without restriction; whatever one wants.

definitions.gloss: I hear that; they say that
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce hearsay or reported information.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{何|なん}でも⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{何|なん}でも⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: If you have any problems, ask me anything.

examples.english: My brother likes books and reads anything. He reads history and novels.

notes:
{何|なん}でも combines ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧ with the particle ⟦でも→でも：noentry⟧, giving "whatever it may be". It has two quite different uses.

ANYTHING / EVERYTHING (sense 1):
- {何|なん}でも⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (eat anything)
- {何|なん}でも⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (anything is fine)
- {何|なん}でも⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (know everything)
With a negative verb the meaning flips to "nothing", but Japanese uses ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧ for that, not {何|なん}でも.

HEARSAY (sense 2):
Sentence-initial, and normally followed by ⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧ or ⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧ at the end:
- {何|なん}でも〜⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧ / ⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧ (I hear that ~)
It marks the whole sentence as secondhand and slightly vague - the speaker is passing on what they heard without vouching for it. A comma after {何|なん}でも is usual in writing.

CAUTION:
{何|なん}でも on its own does NOT mean "by all means" or "at any cost". That is the fixed expression ⟦{何|なに}が{何|なん}でも→何が何でも：16916_naniganandemo⟧, which needs the full four-element form: {何|なに}が{何|なん}でも⟦{勝|か}ちたい→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (I want to win no matter what), not ×{何|なん}でも{勝|か}ちたい. ⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧ is a close everyday equivalent.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧ (nothing - with a negative)
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧ (something)
- ⟦{何|なん}でもかんでも→何でもかんでも：20633_nandemokandemo⟧ (anything and everything, indiscriminately - emphatic, often disapproving)
- ⟦{何|なん}でもない→何でもない：19894_nandemonai⟧ (it's nothing, no big deal)
- ⟦{誰|だれ}でも→誰でも：08498_daredemo⟧ (anyone), ⟦いつでも→いつでも：03826_itsudemo⟧ (anytime), ⟦どこでも→どこでも：08499_dokodemo⟧ (anywhere) - the same 〜でも pattern on other question words
